title: Partner-Network Work and the Rate Further Cost Is Accepted At
content:
Where the work on a vehicle protected by the Keyturn Host Protection Plan was carried out in the partner network, the marketplace accepts more of the further cost.

- Where two or more workshop visits on the vehicle in the three months before were carried out in the partner network, the cost is accepted at the full partner-network rate, a rate of 1, leaving the cost whole.
- Where exactly one visit in that period was carried out in the partner network, it is accepted at the marketplace's mixed-network rate of 94 percent.
- Where none was, it is accepted at the marketplace's unmanaged-repair rate of 86 percent.

### Worked readings (hypothetical figures, on work counted of 2000)

| Partner-network visits in the three months before | Cost accepted at | Leaves |
|---|---|---|
| 2 or more | the whole of it | 2000.00 |
| exactly 1 | 94 percent | 1880.00 |
| none | 86 percent | 1720.00 |

Exactly one partner-network visit is its own reading: it is neither the two that leave the cost whole nor the none that puts it on the lowest rate.

### Source of the readings

The workshop visits carried out in the partner network are read from the Keyturn Vehicle Care Plan held on that vehicle, counting visits within the three months before.
